Design lang"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"uage derived from open-claude-ui."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"**English** | 简体中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"# HwFee-dsh"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Six plugins for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**: a Claude Design System theme, font and size settings, a "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"usage panel, generative UI cards, next-prompt prediction, and Git Bash behind a `run_shell` tool."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Chinese UI: assets/screenshot-home-zh.png."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## The six plugins"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Package | What it does | Install as |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| `dsh-cds-theme` | Replaces the host's look: palette, typography, radii, shadows, and component sty"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ling for code blocks, tables and tool cards | `dsh-cds-theme` |
| `dsh-system-fonts` | Font pickers "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"for content, code, terminal and interface, plus inline-code and interface sizes, line height and tra"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"cking | `dsh-system-fonts` |
| `@hwfee/dsh-usage-stats` | Usage panel on the new-session page, aggre"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"gated from local session logs | `@hwfee/dsh-usage-stats` |
| `@hwfee/dsh-genui` | `render_ui`: the m"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"odel answers with an interactive card instead of prose | `@hwfee/dsh-genui` |
| `@hwfee/dsh-git-bash"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"` | Routes `run_shell` through Git Bash on Windows, with a shell setting | `@hwfee/dsh-git-bash` |
|"},{"id":"p8s8","text":" `@hwfee/dsh-predict` | Faint suggestion of your next message in the composer; Tab fills it in | `@h"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"t` | Faint suggestion of your next message in the composer; Tab fills it in | `@hwfee/dsh-predict` |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Each plugin is a separate package with its own manifest, prebuilt client bundle and test suite. Inst"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"all one or all six; disabling any of them restores the host."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## What each plugin does"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### `dsh-cds-theme` — Claude-style theme"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"319 design tokens through the host's `overrideTokens` path (173 colour, 133 typography, 13 radius/sh"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"adow/motion, light and dark), plus component rules layered on stable `data-*` hooks rather than the "},{"id":"p12s3","text":"host's hashed class names."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- **Component work**: serif display greeting on the blank page; framed Markdown tables with tinted h"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"eaders and tabular numerals; white code blocks in light mode, `#1a1a19` in dark; a unified single-ca"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"rd layout for tool calls; theme-rendered diff and write cards with per-language syntax colour and wo"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"rd-level change highlighting.
- **A "Theme" settings page** beside General: light/dark/system, four "},{"id":"p13s5","text":"accents, surface warmth, radius scale, shadow intensity, component-polish toggle, CJK font priority,"},{"id":"p13s6","text":" long-paste-to-file, and an ASCII ocean on the blank page. Whale colours can be black, DeepSeek blue"},{"id":"p13s7","text":" or changing; reduced motion freezes the scene.
- **Code blocks wrap by default**, and the host's "n"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"o wrap" toggle is removed — no-wrap is not a state this theme offers."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Limit: the theme targets specific host hooks and slots; a host change to those hooks can leave a com"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ponent rule matching nothing until the plugin is updated. "Component polish" can be turned off to fa"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ll back to token-only theming."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Full settings list and implementation notes: `plugins/cds-theme/README.md`."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### `dsh-system-fonts` — fonts and spacing"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Four font slots**: content, code, terminal, and an interface family that follows the body until "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"you set it. The host's three rows are replaced in place rather than duplicated.
- **Two pixel steppe"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"rs**: interface size (10–20px, 14px when unset) scales interface text without moving layout; inline-"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"code size (10–20px, 12px when unset) affects inline code only.
- **Line height and tracking sliders*"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"*, applied live.
- **Windows font discovery** merges GDI families, the registry and per-file OpenTyp"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"e names, so `PingFang SC` and `苹方-简` land in one entry."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Limit: it changes family and spacing only — no `font-weight`, no colour. Sizes hardcoded in the host"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"'s own CSS modules (sidebar and settings-row text) are not reachable from CSS; interface size reache"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"s text nodes, not every fixed px."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Row order and font discovery: `plugins/system-fonts/README.md`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### `@hwfee/dsh-usage-stats` — local usage panel"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"A card under the greeting on the blank page, computed entirely from `~/.dsh/sessions` with no networ"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"er the greeting on the blank page, computed entirely from `~/.dsh/sessions` with no network request:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Six counters** — sessions, messages, tokens, active days, peak hour, top model — plus a Models t"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ab with token shares, switchable between all time, 30 days and 7 days.
- **Activity heatmap** whose "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"last cell is always today, and a comparison against a classic novel's word count.
- **Persistent led"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ger**: first cold scan takes seconds, later starts read a cache in `~/.dsh/cache/usage-stats/`. Coun"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ts only grow — deleting a session's log does not remove it from the totals; delete the ledger file t"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ow — deleting a session's log does not remove it from the totals; delete the ledger file to rebuild."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The panel is the card under the greeting in the screenshot at the top of this page."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Limit: it reads local logs, so a fresh machine starts at zero; the totals are a ledger, not a snapsh"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ot of what is on disk."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Cache, ledger and height setting: `plugins/usage-stats/README.md`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### `@hwfee/dsh-genui` — generative UI cards"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The model calls `render_ui` and the result is a live React card in the conversation: charts, compari"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"son tables, forms, toggles. Buttons change card state."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"- **Card code runs in a sandboxed iframe** with `sandbox="allow-scripts"` and no `allow-same-origin`"},{"id":"p28s2","text":", so its document has an opaque origin; a CSP inside it removes the documented network APIs, navigat"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ion, nested frames and forms.
- **`interact()` is a request, not a send.** The host draws a confirma"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"tion row outside the frame with the exact sentence and send/discard buttons; only a click sends.

Sending needs a click on the host's confirmati"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"on row. This does not make model-written code harmless, and the CSP covers the documented network AP"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"Is — extensions and proxies are outside it |
| `git-bash` | On Windows, Git Bash cannot enter the ho"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"st sandbox, so restricted or undetermined sessions are refused before any process starts; only `dang"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"er-full-access` runs directly. Cancellation, timeout and output overrun stop the process tree |
| `p"},{"id":"p32s7","text":"redict` | Sends the last few turns to the provider you configured, as a normal model request |
| `us"},{"id":"p32s8","text":"age-stats` | Reads `~/.dsh/sessions` and writes a count ledger; no network |"}],"truncated":true}
